slides.title: Introduction to Anatomy
slides.english_text:
Introduction to Anatomy
Anatomy
• The science of the structures & functions of the body
Anatomical Position
• Standing erect
• Head, eyes, and toes directed anteriorly/ forward
• Upper limb by the sides with palms facing anteriorly
• Lower limb close together with feet parallel & toes directed anteriorly

slides.title: Terminology Related to Positions
slides.english_text:
Terminology Related to Positions
Ipsilateral
• refers to the same side of the body
Bilateral
• paired structures in both right & left sides
Contralateral
• refers to opposite sides of the body
Supine
• lying face upward
Prone
• lying face downward
slides.raw_bilingual_text:

與位置相關的術語
Ipsilateral 同側
• refers to the same side of the body 指身體的同一側
Bilateral 雙側
• paired structures in both right & left sides 左右兩側的成對結構
Contralateral 對側
• refers to opposite sides of the body指身體的相對兩側
Supine 仰臥
• lying face upward 面朝上躺著
Prone 俯臥
• lying face downward 面朝下躺著

slides.title: Terminology Related to Movements
slides.english_text:
Terminology Related to Movements
Flexion
• Joint bending movement takes place in a sagittal plane
• decreasing in joint angle
Extension
• movement along sagittal plane that straighten the joint with increasing in joint angle.
Lateral flexion
• Movement of the trunk in the coronal plane
slides.raw_bilingual_text:
Terminology Related to Movements
與動作相關的術語
Flexion 屈曲- F, Flex
• Joint bending movement takes place in a
sagittal plane
發生在矢狀平面上的關節彎曲活動
• decreasing in joint angle 關節角度減小
Extension 伸展- Ext
• movement along sagittal plane that straighten the
joint with increasing in joint angle.
沿矢狀平面伸直關節的活動，使關節角度增加
Lateral flexion 側屈 - LF
• Movement of the trunk in the coronal plane
軀幹在冠狀平面上的活動

slides.title: Terminology Related to Movements
slides.english_text:
Terminology Related to Movements
Abduction
• The limb moving away from midline of the body, along the coronal plane
Adduction
• The limb moving towards body in the coronal plane
Rotation
• Turning of a bone along its longitudinal axis

•

肢體沿冠狀平面向身體移動
Rotation 旋轉 - Rot
• Turning of a bone along its longitudinal axis 骨骼沿其縱軸旋轉

slides.title: Terminology Related to Movements
slides.english_text:
Terminology Related to Movements
Medial/ Internal rotation
• Movement that results in the anterior surface of the body part facing medially
Lateral/ External Rotation
• Movement that results in the anterior surface of the body part facing laterally
Circumduction
• Joint movement that combines Flexion, Abduction, Extension and Adduction sequentially
• Hip: https://youtu.be/5J8lmhectY4?si=kUkniLG6wDCvjyyP

slides.title: Terminology Related to Movements
slides.english_text:
Terminology Related to Movements
Dorsiflexion
Movement at sagittal plane, lifting foot that dorsum approaches the shin.
Plantarflexion
movement at sagittal plane, depressing foot.
Inversion
movement of foot so the sole turns medially
Eversion
movement of foot so the sole faces laterally
Ankle https://youtu.be/ViRsbvnL6uQ?si=BnolPNo6pbg0GbiQ

slides.title: Terminologies related to Bone Markings
slides.english_text:
Terminologies related to Bone Markings
Condyle
• rounded articular projection (e.g. femoral condyle), articulates with corresponding fossa
Epicondyle
• eminence superior to a condyle
Crest
• narrow ridge of bone, usually prominent (e.g. iliac crest)
Malleolus
• rounded prominence (e.g. lateral malleolus)

corresponding fossa

Epicondyle上髁
•
eminence superior to a condyle 髁上方之隆起
Crest 嵴
•
narrow ridge of bone, usually prominent (e.g. iliac crest)
狹窄的骨脊，通常突出（例如 髂嵴）
Malleolus踝
•
rounded prominence (e.g. lateral malleolus)
圓形突起（例如 外踝）

slides.title: Terminologies related to Bone Markings
slides.english_text:
Terminologies related to Bone Markings
Spine
• Thorn-like process(e.g. scapula spine)/sharp, slender often pointed projection (e.g. spinous process)
Tubercle
• Small rounded process/ projection e.g. greater tubercle of the humerus
Tuberosity
• Large rounded elevation e.g. tibial tuberosity
Trochanter
• Large blunt elevation, irregular shape process e.g. greater trochanter of femur
slides.raw_bilingual_text:
Terminologies related to Bone Markings
與骨骼標記相關的術語
Spine 棘
•
Thorn-like process(e.g. scapula spine)/sharp, slender often pointed
projection (e.g. spinous process)
棘狀突（如肩胛岡）/銳利、細長而通常尖的突起（如棘突）
Tubercle 結節
•
Small rounded process/ projection 小而圓的突起
e.g. greater tubercle of the humerus 例如 肱骨大結節
Tuberosity 粗隆
•
Large rounded elevation e.g. tibial tuberosity
大的圓形隆起，例如脛骨粗隆
Trochanter 轉子
•
Large blunt elevation, irregular shape process
大而鈍的隆起，不規則的形狀的突起
e.g. greater trochanter of femur 例如：股骨大轉子
